description: Details pursuant to the partial discharge of Condition 8 (Contaminated Land) of planning permission ref. 61508/APP/2025/204, dated 02-05-2025 (Erection of a two storey 2-bed dwelling with a new dropped kerb, associated parking and amenity space (amended drawings))
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: Condition 8(i)(a) attached to planning permission ref. 61508/APP/2025/204 has been discharged under a previous application reference 61508/APP/2025/3013. The details submitted under this application are considered satisfactory to discharge Condition 8(i)(b & c) only.

The requirements of Condition 8(ii-iv), relating to unexpected contamination, verification reporting and imported soil, remain outstanding and further details must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before these parts of the condition can be discharged.
